description: This file defines API endpoints for project management within a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, and updating projects with database interaction and JWT-based user authentication.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates the user info from a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

methods.name: List[Project] list_projects(payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects for the user's active organization.

methods.name: Project create_project( data: ProjectCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Creates a new project associated with the user's active organization.

methods.name: Project update_project( project_id: str, data: ProjectUpdate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Updates an existing project's name or description within the active organization.

ctags.name: create_project
ctags.signature: ( data: ProjectCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )

ctags.name: update_project
ctags.signature: ( project_id: str, data: ProjectUpdate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
